To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

\begin{enumerate} \item Fine-tuning a trained Deep Reinforcement Learning agent is often not effective for transferring to a similar, but not identical, domain \item Learning a mapping function between domains can substantially improve the transfer \item The mapping function is more efficient to learn than retraining the agent from scratch \end{enumerate}

1) fine-tuning a trained agent to a new domain is not effective, 2) using a GAN to translate images from the new domain to the known one allows us to transfer knowledge, 3) the GAN is trained faster than a re-trained agent, and 4) the transfer is effective even when using only 5% of the data.
1. Using a GAN to learn to translate between different variations of the same game, or between different levels of the same game can significantly improve transfer learning.

the transfer learning process can be improved by using a dedicated mapping component that translates between the source and target task.
